summary.text: Laura Huber is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Tim Dunn.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described a career in mental health that has included work as a counselor in a jail, overseeing crisis mobile teams, working in psychiatric hospitals and doing homeless outreach.

paragraphs.text: Huber said in a Ballotpedia survey that she comes from five generations of farmers and ranchers and grew up on wildlife refuges.
She said that background led her into a career in mental health.
In the survey, Huber listed her campaign messages as economic security and community wellbeing, climate, water and environmental stewardship, and education and opportunity.
She said she is running as a Clean Elections candidate.
Huber advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026, with 11,239 votes in an uncontested race.
